import pandas as pd, altair as alt
s_all = pd.read_csv('report-sources.csv', parse_dates=['report_date_utc'])
day = s_all.report_date_utc.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('included reports, all dates:', len(s_all))
print('in 2026-04-13..2026-06-21:', int(((day >= '2026-04-13') & (day <= '2026-06-21')).sum()))
s = s_all[s_all.report_date_utc >= '2025-11-01'].copy()
print('shown in chart (from 2025-11-01):', len(s))
top = s.data_source.value_counts().index[:6].tolist()
s['source'] = s.data_source.where(s.data_source.isin(top), 'Other (34 sources)')
s['week'] = s.report_date_utc.dt.tz_localize(None).dt.to_period('W-SUN').dt.start_time
w = s.groupby(['week', 'source']).size().reset_index(name='reports')
order = top + ['Other (34 sources)']
print(s_all.data_source.value_counts().head(6).to_string())
alt.Chart(w).mark_bar().encode(
    x=alt.X('week:T', title='Week (UTC)', axis=alt.Axis(format='%b %Y')),
    y=alt.Y('reports:Q', title='Included reports per week'),
    color=alt.Color('source:N', sort=order, title='Data source'),
    order=alt.Order('source_order:Q'),
    tooltip=['week:T', 'source:N', 'reports:Q'],
).transform_calculate(source_order=f"indexof({order}, datum.source)").properties(width=620, height=300)

cells.title: How much of the strongest evidence is also in the outside research-activity cohort?
cells.takeaway: Nearly all: [[6,315|card:e2e3a3fc@out0#L1]] of [[6,464|card:e2e3a3fc@out0#L1]] task-code reports also carry the outside cohort's tag, and the cohort's first report comes minutes before the first task code. The package does not say how that cohort was chosen [[methods.json#/48]].
cells.code:
import thimble, pandas as pd, altair as alt
lab = thimble.labels('evidence basis', negatives=True)
rep = pd.read_csv('all-reports.csv', dtype=str).fillna('')
rep['row'] = range(1, len(rep) + 1)
lab['row'] = lab['line'] - 1
df = rep.merge(lab[['row', 'effective']], on='row')
df = df[df.disposition == 'included']
df['cohort'] = df.why_included.str.contains('externally selected research-activity cohort').map({True: 'in outside cohort', False: 'not in cohort'})
g = df.groupby(['effective', 'cohort']).size().reset_index(name='reports')
code = df[df.effective == 'task code or payload']
print('task code or payload:', len(code), '| in outside cohort:', int((code.cohort == 'in outside cohort').sum()))
src = df[df.effective == 'source match only']
print('source match only:', len(src), '| in outside cohort:', int((src.cohort == 'in outside cohort').sum()))
coh = df[df.cohort == 'in outside cohort']
print('first cohort report (UTC):', coh.report_date_utc.min())
print('first task-code report (UTC):', code.report_date_utc.min())
print('first task-code report not in cohort (UTC):', code[code.cohort == 'not in cohort'].report_date_utc.min())
order = ['task code or payload', 'intermediary', 'other evidence', 'source match only']
alt.Chart(g).mark_bar().encode(
    y=alt.Y('effective:N', sort=order, title='Evidence basis (label)'),
    x=alt.X('reports:Q', title='Included reports'),
    color=alt.Color('cohort:N', title='Outside cohort'),
    tooltip=['effective', 'cohort', 'reports'],
).properties(width=560, height=180)

cells.title: Which of the catalog's labels and controls should the analyst treat with care?
cells.takeaway: [[114|card:ca822fc8#reports/Included%20only%20through%20an%20outside%20cohort%20tag]] rows that still say "needs review" were included with no evidence except the outside cohort tag. And [[70|card:ca822fc8#reports/'Ordinary'%20MAX%20controls%20on%20May%2026%20(MAX%20burst%20day)]] of the [[73|card:ca822fc8#reports/'Ordinary'%20MAX%20controls,%20all%20dates]] "ordinary" MAX controls fall on the MAX burst day, so they may not be independent of it.
cells.code:
import pandas as pd
r = pd.read_csv('all-reports.csv', dtype=str).fillna('')
r['row'] = range(1, len(r) + 1)
src = pd.read_csv('report-sources.csv', dtype=str)[['report_id', 'data_source']]
r = r.merge(src, on='report_id', how='left')
w = r.why_included
inc = r.disposition == 'included'
DISC = w.str.contains('Explicit reference or discovery candidate')
COH = w.str.contains('externally selected research-activity cohort')
SRC = w.str.contains('Related data source or exact task identifier')
CODE = w.str.contains('Supplied task-specific code')
INTER = w.str.contains('uses an intermediary')
maxord = w.str.contains('Ordinary MAX portal/login traffic')
iowa_cohort = w.str.contains('cohort: Iowa public health / CDC')
checks = [
    ("Included, but text still says 'needs review'", inc & DISC),
    ("Included only through an outside cohort tag", inc & DISC & COH & ~SRC & ~CODE & ~INTER),
    ("Significant, but no data source named", (r.confidence == 'significant') & (r.data_source == 'Source not identified')),
    ("'Ordinary' MAX controls, all dates", maxord),
    ("'Ordinary' MAX controls on May 26 (MAX burst day)", maxord & r.report_date_utc.str.startswith('2026-05-26')),
    ("Iowa CDC cohort tag filed under thyroid statistics", iowa_cohort & (r.data_source == 'Iowa thyroid statistics')),
]
t = pd.DataFrame([{'issue': name, 'reports': int(m.sum()), 'first row': int(r.row[m].iloc[0])} for name, m in checks]).set_index('issue')
t
